description: KPIs and bottlenecks of the “Smooth” run.

description: Pick a target run and how many proposals; the LLM drafts structured improvement proposals.

description: The local LLM is generating proposals for the WaitingProblem run.

description: Each draft has a title, the bottleneck it targets, typed changes (capacity / stagger orders / reroute / add entity), expected impact and risks — validated against the yard's entities.

title: AI-generated proposal drafts (continued)
description: More drafts from the same generation run.

title: Saved proposal
description: A saved proposal can be discussed with the AI or (once the partner API is live) sent to the simulator for re-evaluation.

description: “Discuss” opens the chat scoped to one proposal and the target run's KPIs: the AI weighs its likely impact and risks before anything is simulated.
